requirements: Built for apps made with Lovable — 'like Product Hunt but for apps built with Lovable' (official launch framing); non-Lovable products are likely out of scope
Account required to submit and to vote
Third-party field list: product name, live URL, 60-character tagline, 250-character description, square logo ≥512px, 2-3 screenshots, pricing model — all required
preparation: Plan to drive upvotes — visibility on the board is engagement-driven
workflow: Open https://launched.lovable.app/ in a real browser (SPA — no useful HTML to fetchers)
Submit the project with the prepared fields
Promote the launched page for upvotes; engagement drives ranking and discovery
watchFor: Platform scope is Lovable-built apps — submitting a non-Lovable product is probably a waste or a rejection
Early submitters hit a backend 'slug violates not-null constraint' bug (per the launch LinkedIn thread) — verify the form actually persists your project
Form reportedly rarely saves drafts — have every field ready before starting
Visibility depends on upvotes; plan an amplification push
countsAsLive: The app has a public project page on launched.lovable.app and appears in the discovery feed with vote counts
unknowns: Whether non-Lovable apps are technically accepted
Current field validation — details came from a third-party guide, not the live form
Whether the site is still actively maintained
